name: TC-907: Lima — the choices and the note on an item inside a deal (a paid size, a nested free sauce under it, a free dip, special instructions) are sent in the /quote and stored on the paid order — the deal upcharge is unchanged
description: Wings + soup @ $12. In the Lima deal builder the wings are customised: Size '20 PC' (+$4.99), 'Buffalo' in the nested Wing Sauce group 20 PC opens, the free 'Ranch Dip', and a note in the item sheet's Special Instructions box. The checkout's /quote body must carry orderDeals[0].items[<wings>].selectedModifiers with all three modifierIds (Buffalo with parentModifierId = 20 PC) and specialInstructions = the note; the server prices the deal at upcharge 4.99 / lineTotal 16.99 (unchanged). Paid with the Stripe test card, the owner read (GET /api/order/:id) must show orderDealItems[<wings>] naming all three choices and carrying the note. Fails on QA until the template-lima + backend deal-item fixes deploy.

Expect "toBeVisible" getByTestId('deal-fixed-step').filter({ has: getByRole('heading', { name: /^(\d+ × )?Lima Wings 3a3b6913$/ }) }).first()

Click getByTestId('deal-fixed-step').filter({ has: getByRole('heading', { name: /^(\d+ × )?Lima Wings 3a3b6913$/ }) }).first().getByTestId('deal-step-customize')
Check getByRole('dialog').getByRole('radio', { name: /^20 PC 3a3b6913/ }).or(getByRole('dialog').getByRole('checkbox', { name: /^20 PC 3a3b6913/ })).first()
Check getByRole('dialog').getByRole('radio', { name: /^Ranch Dip 3a3b6913/ }).or(getByRole('dialog').getByRole('checkbox', { name: /^Ranch Dip 3a3b6913/ })).first()
Expect "toBeChecked" getByRole('dialog').getByRole('radio', { name: /^20 PC 3a3b6913/ }).or(getByRole('dialog').getByRole('checkbox', { name: /^20 PC 3a3b6913/ })).first()
Expect "toBeChecked" getByRole('dialog').getByRole('radio', { name: /^Ranch Dip 3a3b6913/ }).or(getByRole('dialog').getByRole('checkbox', { name: /^Ranch Dip 3a3b6913/ })).first()
Fill "extra crispy please 3a3b6913" getByRole('dialog').getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Special Instructions' })
Expect "toContainText" getByTestId('deal-fixed-step').filter({ has: getByRole('heading', { name: /^(\d+ × )?Lima Wings 3a3b6913$/ }) }).getByTestId('deal-step-options')
Checkout /quote: priced as before, and the choices + note are sent
Click getByRole('button', { name: 'View Cart', exact: true })
